definitions.short: Chariph , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H2756. Chariph חָרִיף חָרִף, proper name, masculine (compare Arabic autumn , see חֹרֶף above) — 1 חָרִף head of a family of returned exiles Neh 7:24 ( ᵐ5 Αρειφ , ᵐ5 L Ιωρηε ) = יוֺרָה (compare יוֺרָה early rain ) Ezra 2:18 ( ᵐ5 Ουρα , A Ιωρα , ᵐ5 L Ωραι ). 2 חָרִיף one of those sealed Neh 10:20 ᵐ5 Αρειφ ( α ), ᵐ5 L Αρηφ .
